status: Three concepts completed; A appearance selected by owner

prompts.a:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original fantasy game CITY CONCEPT for owner approval, NOT a cinematic illustration or runtime asset.
Primary request: one complete inhabited small fantasy town in a continuous green playable world, viewed in the fixed elevated orthographic isometric tactical camera used by a stylized tower-defense RPG. Entire layout visible from above, no horizon, no perspective convergence, same roughly55degree elevation and same human scale across alternatives. One full landscape16:9 image, no panels/collage.
Style/medium: high-quality hand-painted cartoon2D game environment with readable chunky volumes, subtle dark contour edges, softly painted warm surfaces, simplified stone/wood/grass textures. Closely unified coherent materials: cream plaster, warm wood, chunky gray masonry, lush yellow-green grass with sparse short turf and tiny flowers, softly shaded conifers beyond town edges. Not pixel art, not photorealistic, not a plastic mobile-game render.
Composition: enough town mass, about10–14distinct modest buildings as an illustrative composition; open generous visible walkable ground. Buildings proportional to human residents, largely1–2storeys. Taller structures at rear, small set-back foreground buildings, no giant landmark dominating. Open lower foreground entrance; traceable clear route along the ground to the sole merchant. Same clear warm daylight and soft contact shadows across variants.
People: one recognisable hero-sized traveler wearing simple leather clothes with a bow near the entrance, plus several equally scaled human residents walking, sitting or talking. EXACTLY ONE visible merchant standing fully visible beside ONE uncovered sales counter with a small offset plum fabric awning that does not hide the merchant. Rolled parchments and a few wrapped goods identify this single trader. No other stalls, service counters, vendors, activity markers, floating text, quest symbols, UI or HUD. Background people have no services.
Constraints: readable continuous flat walking surfaces, no treehouses, no raised platforms, no playable stairs, no bridges over a route, no roofed pedestrian tunnels. Broad gaps among roof silhouettes keep people visible. No castle/palace, faction emblems, weapons combat, giant crystal tower, diorama base or floating island. No text, labels, legends, logos or watermarks. Original architecture, do not reproduce any named franchise.
Variant A ONLY: compact FAN-SHAPED town around a broad triangular COBBLESTONE SQUARE. Warm timber framing, cream plaster, chunky gray stone foundations, steep TERRACOTTA GABLED roofs. Three separated lanes radiate from the square between short irregular rows of houses. A few two-storey houses define the rear roofline, small foreground houses set back. Lower entrance opens directly onto the square. Place sole merchant on near-right square edge facing entrance, one modest offset plum awning, uncovered counter. Mostly open square with small off-centre well, benches, a few planters. Inhabited, substantial medieval fantasy town through varied grouped houses, not a huge central building. Distinctive angular roof skyline.
